avoid: Staying with NFC when compatibility equivalences matter (ligatures, vertical forms, character variants)
Using .lower() alone without .casefold() for Unicode text—casefold handles edge cases .lower() misses
Switching normalization forms without reconsidering case-folding strategy; both must evolve together
strategy: Replace 'NFC' with 'NFKC' in normalize() call—NFKC handles compatibility decompositions (ligatures, variant forms, precomposed characters)
Replace .lower() with .casefold()—proper Unicode case-folding for edge cases (ß→ss, ı→i, etc.)
Test with ligatures (ﬁ), combining marks, diacritics (é), and special case pairs
If NFKC+casefold fails, try reverse order: text.casefold() then normalize('NFKC', ...)
genes.summary: After NFC+lower and NFD+casefold both fail independently, upgrade to NFKC (compatibility) normalization with casefold() for complete Unicode equivalence.
